lines.commandPath: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$r/.claude/workflow.config" ] || exit 0; for q in "$HOME/.claude/scripts/statusline-role.sh" "$r/.claude/scripts/statusline-role.sh"; do [ -x "$q" ] && { "$q"; break; }; done; exit 0'

sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$r/.claude/workflow.config" ] || exit 0; for q in "$HOME/.claude/scripts/statusline-fleet.sh" "$r/.claude/scripts/statusline-fleet.sh"; do [ -x "$q" ] && { "$q"; break; }; done; exit 0'

sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -f "$r/.claude/workflow.config" ] || exit 0; for q in "$HOME/.claude/scripts/statusline-pr.sh" "$r/.claude/scripts/statusline-pr.sh"; do [ -x "$q" ] && { "$q"; break; }; done; exit 0'

sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; for q in "$HOME/.claude/scripts/statusline-todo.sh" "$r/.claude/scripts/statusline-todo.sh"; do [ -x "$q" ] || continue; out=$("$q" </dev/null) || exit 0; [ -n "$out" ] && printf "\033[38;5;16m%s\033[39m" "$out"; break; done; exit 0'
